responsibility: This file implements the lowest-level heap allocator wrapper for GNU Modula-2's mc-boot runtime. It owns the concrete ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, REALLOCATE, availability-probe, and initialization routines that call libc malloc/free/realloc directly, optionally zero freed memory and emit allocation traces under environment-variable control, and convert out-of-memory conditions into Debug_Halt failures, making it the system-facing storage backend underneath the higher-level Storage module.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the concrete backend implementation in the GSysStorage pair: it directly calls libc malloc/free/realloc, handles out-of-memory halts, and supports optional zeroing and trace environment flags, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GSysStorage.h only declares that low-level allocator interface.
